items.title: Make your pet the narrator
items.description: Turn a pet portrait and a short voice track into a talking-animal concept.
items.evidence: Provider describes talking-animal generation.
items.inputs: A clear pet portrait and an audio clip you own.
steps: Choose a front-facing portrait.
Record an original short voiceover.
Generate with the provider and review the mouth movement.
items.prompt: Create a warm, playful talking-pet clip using my reference photo and original voiceover. Preserve the pet’s markings. Keep movements subtle. Do not add people or logos.
items.caution: Photo consent and voice rights matter. Animal lip sync can fail.

items.title: Give your pet a dance-floor moment
items.description: Explore a photo-to-dance template without writing a long technical prompt.
items.evidence: Provider publishes pet and human dance templates.
items.inputs: One pet photo; some templates require two.
steps: Browse the live template library.
Check required photos, credit cost and music terms.
Generate and review anatomy before sharing.
items.prompt: Design an original short pet dance concept from my photo. Use a gentle bounce, recognizable fur markings and a fixed camera. Use original or properly licensed audio.
items.caution: Template availability, music rights and provider charges vary.

items.title: Remix a character’s movement
items.description: Use character-motion tools for an original meme or performance concept.
items.evidence: Official platform provides motion-focused AI creation.
items.inputs: A character image and a movement concept.
steps: Explore the provider’s creation tools.
Use a character image you have permission to animate.
Test one short motion and inspect the output.
items.prompt: Help me storyboard an original 6-second character-motion remix. Explain the input assets I need and suggest a simple movement that avoids complex occlusion.
items.caution: Check likeness consent and the rights to any reference performance.

items.title: Bring a product photo to life
items.description: Plan a short product reveal from a single clean reference image.
items.evidence: Official page describes product image-to-video.
items.inputs: A product image and a simple shot idea.
steps: Prepare a clean product image.
Describe one camera move and one product action.
Generate externally and check logos and shape.
items.prompt: Create a short product reveal from this image. Keep packaging, logo and proportions unchanged. Use soft studio light and a slow camera orbit. No additional text.
items.caution: Small text, logos and product geometry may change during generation.

items.title: Try a nostalgic yearbook portrait
items.description: Explore portrait styles and build a specific creative brief before spending credits.
items.evidence: Official product offers AI image and video generation.
items.inputs: Portrait references accepted by the provider.
steps: Check the provider’s current photo requirements.
Choose era, lighting and wardrobe cues.
Review face consistency and download terms.
items.prompt: Create a 1990s school-portrait concept: soft studio flash, a blue mottled backdrop and restrained film grain. Preserve identity and natural skin texture. No school logo.
items.caution: This is a style idea, not a verified template or guaranteed likeness result.

items.title: Turn an idea into a social design
items.description: Build a visual concept, then refine layout and readable copy in a design editor.
items.evidence: Official page describes AI design and creative tools.
items.inputs: A topic, audience and desired format.
steps: Describe the audience and main message.
Ask for one visual direction and short headline.
Edit typography and verify export rights.
items.prompt: Design a square social post for [audience] about [topic]. Use one clear headline, generous negative space and a simple visual hierarchy. Provide three concise copy options.
items.caution: Review generated text, stock licensing and brand accuracy.

items.title: Edit a video through its transcript
items.description: Use transcript-led editing to tighten a spoken video and create a clearer story.
items.evidence: Official product describes text-based video and audio editing.
items.inputs: A recorded video or audio file.
steps: Import a recording you own.
Review the transcript for errors.
Make a short edit and inspect timing and captions.
items.prompt: Review this transcript for repetition, long pauses and unclear explanations. Suggest a tighter edit while preserving the speaker’s meaning. Do not invent quotes.
items.caution: Transcription accuracy varies; check names and caption timing.

items.title: Find an automation starting point
items.description: Search community workflows and adapt one to your own apps and data.
items.evidence: Official library lists workflow automation templates.
items.inputs: A repeated task and access to the required apps.
steps: Describe the trigger and desired result.
Inspect a template’s integrations and code.
Test with sample data before using live accounts.
items.prompt: Design a workflow for [task]. Specify trigger, input schema, validation, actions and failure handling. Prepare drafts for external messages rather than sending automatically.
items.caution: Templates are not audited here. Hosting and model/API usage may cost money.

items.title: Connect a simple workflow visually
items.description: Map a trigger, transformation and destination before building a larger process.
items.evidence: Official platform publishes workflow templates.
items.inputs: Two apps and a clearly defined recurring task.
steps: Choose a small task with observable output.
Inspect the template and connection requirements.
Run sample records and check failures and duplicates.
items.prompt: Map [task] as trigger → validation → transformation → destination. Include duplicate protection and an error notification. List the permissions each app needs.
items.caution: App permissions, operation allowances and third-party fees differ.

items.title: Start with a prebuilt app connection
items.description: Use a template to connect tools, then inspect the exact actions before activation.
items.evidence: Official site publishes automation templates.
items.inputs: A trigger app and a destination app.
steps: Search templates for your two apps.
Check each action and its account access.
Test a sample and enable only the approved actions.
items.prompt: Help me plan an automation between [app A] and [app B]. Identify the trigger, field mapping, missing-data behavior and duplicate handling. Show the test plan before activation.
items.caution: A template is not proof of reliability for your data or accounts.

items.title: Turn a Linear issue into a research request
items.description: A published template connects Linear commands to web research and returns analysis as issue comments.
items.evidence: The template publisher describes Linear-triggered search, trend analysis and crawling. This is a published workflow description, not our test result.
items.inputs: A Linear workspace, n8n setup and the template's provider credentials.
steps: Read the template and inspect required services.
Test a research command in a sample Linear issue.
Review the analysis and sources before relying on them.
items.prompt: Plan a research assistant that receives a topic from an issue, collects original sources and drafts a cited analysis. Keep any external posting disabled until reviewed.
items.caution: The template is older, not newly released. External services and model usage may cost money; permissions and source quality need review.

items.title: Build a research loop with source citations
items.description: Explore an n8n template that combines query planning, search, content extraction and report generation.
items.evidence: The published template describes an iterative search-and-analysis workflow using external APIs and a source-linked final report. We did not execute it.
items.inputs: n8n and the model, search and extraction services specified by the template.
steps: Review the integrations and API requirements.
Test with a narrow non-sensitive research topic.
Inspect citations and verify source support manually.
items.prompt: Research [topic] from original sources. Separate source facts, author claims and your inferences. Stop when evidence is insufficient, and list unresolved questions.
items.caution: Free template access does not mean free API execution. Search and model providers may charge. This is newly added to our directory, not a newly published tool.

items.title: Explore a browser agent for repeatable web tasks
items.description: The project offers a Python agent library, CLI integration and a separately hosted cloud service for browser tasks.
items.evidence: The official repository documents local-library, CLI and hosted-cloud options. It states that model inference and cloud browser services can have separate charges.
items.inputs: A chosen deployment path, supported runtime and the provider credentials needed for that path.
steps: Read the official setup guide and choose local or hosted operation.
Begin with a read-only task on a site that permits the access.
Review results and add logging before scheduling repeat tasks.
items.prompt: Plan a read-only browser task to collect [public information] from [source]. Respect access restrictions, record source URLs and timestamps, and report failures instead of bypassing them.
items.caution: No browser or AI model guarantees success on every website. Account access and external writes require separate authorization. Model and hosting charges may apply.

items.title: Delegate a task across connected apps
items.description: Google's October 13 announcement describes a Tasks mode for work across connected apps, including while the user is away.
items.evidence: Google describes Tasks mode and connected-app actions. These are vendor capabilities, not independently tested outcomes.
items.inputs: An eligible Google account, supported plan and app connections.
steps: Check account and regional availability.
Connect only the apps needed for one task.
Review permissions and any booking or purchase before confirmation.
items.prompt: Plan [task] using my connected apps. Identify missing information and permissions. Ask before any purchase, booking or external message.
items.caution: Google names Pro and Ultra access. Availability and app permissions vary; completion is not guaranteed.

items.title: Explore a fast agent for ticket triage
items.description: Anthropic describes the model for repetitive agent work and publishes Asana's account of testing bug triage and project tasks.
items.evidence: The launch page includes a named customer's evaluation account. We did not reproduce it and do not treat its performance claims as independent findings.
items.inputs: A labeled test set of non-sensitive tickets and access to the chosen model.
steps: Define labels and an escalation rule.
Evaluate a small historical sample.
Review uncertain classifications before connecting live tools.
items.prompt: Classify these sample tickets using [labels]. Give a short rationale and mark ambiguous items for review. Do not change live records.
items.caution: API charges may apply. A vendor's customer example does not establish accuracy on your tickets.

items.title: Try a conversational calendar assistant
items.description: A published beginner template describes retrieving calendar events and creating them through an AI agent.
items.evidence: The template author lists two calendar capabilities. The template is older; this is a new directory entry, not a new product release.
items.inputs: n8n, Google Calendar access and the template's model credentials.
steps: Inspect the template and credential scopes.
Start by retrieving events from a test calendar.
Confirm timezone and event details before enabling creation.
items.prompt: Find availability in this test calendar for [time range]. Draft an event with an explicit timezone and ask for confirmation before creating or inviting anyone.
items.caution: Template access and API usage are separate. Verify model costs and account permissions.

items.title: Turn a video into a content bundle
items.description: Generate reusable drafts from a YouTube transcript and organize them in a spreadsheet.
items.evidence: Ravi Patel's template describes transcript retrieval, Gemini drafts, spreadsheet logging and LinkedIn publishing. Author documentation; not our test.
items.inputs: A permitted video URL, n8n, RapidAPI, Gemini and Google Sheets credentials.
steps: Inspect the template and disable LinkedIn publishing.
Configure transcript access and draft destinations.
Review generated copy against the transcript.
items.prompt: Draft a short article and social post from this transcript. Preserve meaning, flag uncertainty and prepare drafts for review.
items.caution: Existing template, not a new release. API charges and content rights need checking; publishing requires account authorization.

zh.title: 把视频整理成一组内容草稿
zh.description: 根据 YouTube 转录生成可复用的草稿，并在电子表格中整理。
zh.evidence: Ravi Patel 的模板介绍了转录获取、Gemini 草稿、表格日志及 LinkedIn 发布。这是作者文档，并非我们的实测。
zh.inputs: 有权使用的视频网址、n8n，以及 RapidAPI、Gemini 和 Google Sheets 凭据。
steps: 检查模板并停用 LinkedIn 发布。
配置转录访问和草稿存放位置。
对照转录审核生成的文案。
zh.prompt: 根据这份转录起草一篇短文和一则社交帖子。保持原意，标出不确定之处，生成供审核的草稿。
zh.caution: 这是已有模板，并非新品。需检查 API 费用和内容使用权；发布需要账户授权。

ja.title: 動画から複数のコンテンツ下書きを作る
ja.description: YouTube の文字起こしから再利用できる下書きを生成し、スプレッドシートに整理します。
ja.evidence: Ravi Patel のテンプレートは文字起こし取得、Gemini による下書き、表への記録、LinkedIn 投稿を説明しています。作者の説明であり、当方の実測ではありません。
ja.inputs: 利用権限のある動画 URL、n8n、RapidAPI・Gemini・Google Sheets の認証情報。
steps: テンプレートを確認し、LinkedIn 投稿を無効にする。
文字起こしへのアクセスと下書きの保存先を設定する。
生成文を文字起こしと照合して確認する。
ja.prompt: この文字起こしから短い記事とソーシャル投稿の下書きを作成してください。意味を保ち、不確実な点を示し、確認用の下書きにしてください。
ja.caution: 既存のテンプレートで、新製品ではありません。API 料金とコンテンツの権利を確認してください。投稿にはアカウントの許可が必要です。

items.title: Plan follow-up meetings from transcripts
items.description: Use meeting transcripts to summarize discussions and identify follow-up meetings.
items.evidence: Jimleuk's template describes an agent that reads transcripts and creates follow-up calendar events with known attendees. This is the author's description, not an independently tested result.
items.inputs: n8n, OpenAI access, Google Calendar and transcript OAuth permissions.
steps: Inspect transcript permissions and use a test calendar.
Review extracted follow-up details.
Confirm attendees, timezone and timing before enabling event creation.
items.prompt: Summarize this transcript and draft any explicitly agreed follow-up meeting. Flag missing dates or attendees; request review before creating events.
items.caution: Older template; exact publication date not established here. Model fees may apply. Calendar writes can send invitations.

zh.title: 根据会议转录规划后续会议
zh.description: 利用会议转录总结讨论，并识别需要安排的后续会议。
zh.evidence: Jimleuk 的模板介绍了读取转录并创建后续日历事件、添加已知参会者的代理。这是作者描述，并非独立实测结果。
zh.inputs: n8n、OpenAI 访问权限、Google Calendar，以及转录所需的 OAuth 权限。
steps: 检查转录权限，并使用测试日历。
审核提取的后续会议详情。
启用事件创建前，确认参会者、时区和时间。
zh.prompt: 总结这份转录，为明确约定的后续会议起草安排。标出缺少的日期或参会者；创建事件前请求审核。
zh.caution: 这是较早的模板，本次未确定准确发布日期。模型调用可能收费。写入日历可能发送邀请。

ja.title: 会議の文字起こしから次回会議を計画する
ja.description: 会議の文字起こしを使って議論を要約し、必要なフォローアップ会議を特定します。
ja.evidence: Jimleuk のテンプレートは、文字起こしを読み、既知の参加者を含む次回会議の予定を作るエージェントを説明しています。作者の説明であり、独立した実測結果ではありません。
ja.inputs: n8n、OpenAI へのアクセス、Google Calendar、文字起こし取得用の OAuth 権限。
steps: 文字起こしの権限を確認し、テスト用カレンダーを使う。
抽出した次回会議の詳細を確認する。
予定作成を有効にする前に、参加者・タイムゾーン・日時を確認する。
ja.prompt: この文字起こしを要約し、明確に合意された次回会議の案を作ってください。不明な日付や参加者を示し、予定作成前に確認を求めてください。
ja.caution: 以前からあるテンプレートで、今回は正確な公開日を確定していません。モデル利用料が発生する場合があります。カレンダーへの書き込みで招待が送信される可能性があります。

items.title: Review pull requests against team rules
items.description: Draft a diff review using coding rules stored in Google Sheets.
items.evidence: Jihene's tutorial describes PR-triggered reviews, comments and labels. Author documentation, not our test.
items.inputs: n8n, repository access, model credentials and optional Google Sheets rules.
steps: Inspect permissions and disable comment and label writes.
Provide a sample diff and relevant team rules.
Have a maintainer review findings.
items.prompt: Review this diff against these rules. Cite changed lines, separate defects from preferences, and draft findings without posting.
items.caution: Older template; exact publication date unknown. Check current model support and costs. An AI-reviewed label is not proof of correctness.

zh.title: 按团队规范审查拉取请求
zh.description: 使用 Google Sheets 中保存的编码规则，为代码差异起草审查意见。
zh.evidence: Jihene 的教程介绍了由拉取请求触发的审查、评论和标签。这是作者文档，并非我们的实测。
zh.inputs: n8n、仓库访问权限、模型凭据，以及可选的 Google Sheets 规则。
steps: 检查权限，停用评论及标签写入。
提供示例代码差异和相关团队规则。
由维护者审核发现的问题。
zh.prompt: 根据这些规则审查这份代码差异。引用变更行，区分缺陷和偏好，仅起草意见，不发布。
zh.caution: 这是较早的模板，准确发布日期未知。需检查当前模型支持及费用。AI 审查标签不代表代码正确。

ja.title: チーム規約に沿ってプルリクエストをレビューする
ja.description: Google Sheets に保存したコーディング規約を使い、差分のレビュー案を作成します。
ja.evidence: Jihene のチュートリアルは、PR を契機とするレビュー、コメント、ラベルを説明しています。作者の説明であり、当方の実測ではありません。
ja.inputs: n8n、リポジトリへのアクセス、モデルの認証情報、任意の Google Sheets 規約。
steps: 権限を確認し、コメントとラベルの書き込みを無効にする。
サンプル差分と関連するチーム規約を用意する。
保守担当者が指摘を確認する。
ja.prompt: この規約に沿って差分をレビューしてください。変更行を示し、不具合と好みを区別して、投稿せずに指摘案を作成してください。
ja.caution: 以前からあるテンプレートで、正確な公開日は不明です。現在のモデル対応と費用を確認してください。AI レビュー済みラベルは正しさの証明ではありません。

items.title: Explore geospatial site screening
items.description: Explore combining candidate locations with environmental and infrastructure data for an initial screening report.
items.evidence: Google's October 14, 2026 announcement describes experimental geospatial agents and partner site-screening work. Vendor account, not independent validation.
items.inputs: Early-access eligibility and permitted location data; the API supports CSV or GeoJSON.
steps: Check experimental access requirements.
Define candidate locations and screening criteria.
Review data sources, assumptions and coverage with an expert.
items.prompt: Plan a screening of these locations for [criteria]. Identify datasets, coverage gaps and assumptions. Produce an expert-review draft, not a final decision.
items.caution: Limited experimental access, not general availability. Pricing is not established here; output requires expert review.

zh.title: 探索地理空间选址初筛
zh.description: 探索将候选地点与环境、基础设施数据结合，生成初步筛选报告。
zh.evidence: Google 在 2026 年 10 月 14 日的公告中介绍了实验性地理空间代理及合作伙伴的选址初筛工作。这是厂商描述，并非独立验证。
zh.inputs: 早期访问资格和有权使用的位置数据；API 支持 CSV 或 GeoJSON。
steps: 检查实验服务的访问要求。
确定候选地点和筛选标准。
与专家审核数据来源、假设及覆盖情况。
zh.prompt: 为这些地点按[标准]制定初筛方案。列出数据集、覆盖缺口和假设。生成供专家审核的草稿，而非最终决策。
zh.caution: 仅限实验性早期访问，并非全面开放。本次未确认定价；输出需要专家审核。

ja.title: 地理空間データで候補地の一次評価を検討する
ja.description: 候補地を環境・インフラデータと組み合わせ、一次評価レポートを作る用途を検討します。
ja.evidence: Google の 2026 年 10 月 14 日の発表は、実験的な地理空間エージェントと提携先による候補地評価を説明しています。ベンダーの説明であり、独立した検証ではありません。
ja.inputs: 早期アクセスの利用資格と利用権限のある位置データ。API は CSV または GeoJSON に対応。
steps: 実験的サービスへのアクセス要件を確認する。
候補地と評価基準を定める。
専門家とデータソース、前提、対象範囲を確認する。
ja.prompt: これらの地点を[基準]で一次評価する計画を作ってください。データセット、対象範囲の欠落、前提を示してください。最終判断ではなく、専門家の確認用草案を作成してください。
ja.caution: 限定的な実験アクセスで、一般提供ではありません。今回は料金を確認していません。出力には専門家の確認が必要です。

items.title: Require approval before an agent acts
items.description: Pause selected agent tool calls so a reviewer can inspect parameters and approve or deny the action.
items.evidence: n8n's official documentation describes per-tool human review and approval channels. Documented capability, not our test.
items.inputs: An n8n AI Agent workflow, selected tools and an authorized review channel.
steps: Add a human review step from the agent Tools panel.
Connect tools that need approval and configure the channel.
Check approval and denial with harmless sample inputs.
items.prompt: Draft [task]. Require human approval for external writes. If denied, report the cancellation and do not retry through another tool.
items.caution: Review actual tool parameters; a prompt alone is not an approval gate. Provider charges may apply. No publication date established here.

zh.title: 在代理执行操作前要求人工批准
zh.description: 暂停选定的代理工具调用，让审核者检查参数，并批准或拒绝该操作。
zh.evidence: n8n 官方文档介绍了针对单个工具的人工审核及审批渠道。这是文档所述能力，并非我们的实测。
zh.inputs: 一个 n8n AI Agent 工作流、选定工具，以及经过授权的审核渠道。
steps: 在代理的 Tools 面板中添加人工审核步骤。
连接需要批准的工具，并配置审核渠道。
用无害的示例输入检查批准和拒绝两条路径。
zh.prompt: 起草[任务]。对外部写入要求人工批准。如被拒绝，报告操作已取消，不要改用其他工具重试。
zh.caution: 审核实际工具参数；仅靠提示词不构成审批关卡。服务商可能收费。本次未确定发布日期。

ja.title: エージェントの操作前に承認を求める
ja.description: 選択したツール呼び出しを一時停止し、確認者がパラメータを確認して承認または拒否できるようにします。
ja.evidence: n8n の公式文書は、ツール単位の人による確認と承認チャネルを説明しています。文書上の機能であり、当方の実測ではありません。
ja.inputs: n8n AI Agent ワークフロー、対象ツール、利用を許可された確認チャネル。
steps: エージェントの Tools パネルから人による確認ステップを追加する。
承認が必要なツールを接続し、確認チャネルを設定する。
無害なサンプル入力で承認と拒否の両経路を確認する。
ja.prompt: [タスク]の案を作成してください。外部への書き込みには人の承認を必要としてください。拒否されたらキャンセルを報告し、別のツールで再試行しないでください。
ja.caution: 実際のツールパラメータを確認してください。プロンプトだけでは承認の仕組みになりません。サービス料金が発生する場合があります。今回は公開日を確定していません。

items.title: Turn a security alert into a draft fix
items.description: Assign an eligible code-scanning alert to an agent that proposes a patch and opens a draft pull request.
items.evidence: GitHub's October 15, 2026 announcement describes repository exploration, fixes and CodeQL reruns. Vendor capability, not our test.
items.inputs: An eligible Enterprise Cloud repository, security entitlement, enabled policies and billing.
steps: Check access policies and Code Security budget.
Select a default-branch alert for assignment.
Review the draft patch and validation before merging.
items.prompt: Propose a minimal fix for this alert. Explain changes and validation, flag uncertainty, and leave a draft for human review.
items.caution: Consumes Code Security AI Credits and Actions minutes. Limited to default-branch alerts; validation does not guarantee security.

zh.title: 把安全告警转成修复草稿
zh.description: 将符合条件的代码扫描告警分配给代理，由其提出补丁并创建草稿拉取请求。
zh.evidence: GitHub 在 2026 年 10 月 15 日的公告中介绍了仓库探索、修复和重新运行 CodeQL。这是厂商能力说明，并非我们的实测。
zh.inputs: 符合条件的 Enterprise Cloud 仓库、安全功能使用资格、已启用的策略及计费配置。
steps: 检查访问策略和 Code Security 预算。
选择默认分支上的告警进行分配。

steps: アクセスのポリシーと Code Security 予算を確認する。
既定ブランチの警告を選んで割り当てる。
マージ前にパッチ案と検証結果を確認する。
ja.prompt: この警告に対する最小限の修正案を示してください。変更と検証を説明し、不確実な点を明記して、人の確認用にドラフトを残してください。
